parties.petitioner: Chief Commissioner of Central Goods and Service Tax & Ors.
parties.respondent: M/s Safari Retreats Private Ltd. & Ors.

summary: Input Tax Credit (ITC) restriction on construction of immovable property; validity of Section 17(5)(c) and 17(5)(d) CGST Act challenged; distinction between commercial property rentals vs property sales; intelligible differentia test for Article 14 violation; dominant intention test applied to works contracts; credit chain continuity argued; cascading tax effect vs GST neutrality objective; High Court judgment read down Section 17(5)(d) based on Eicher Motors precedent; constitutional challenges under Articles 14, 19(1)(g) and 300A; assessment of nexus between legislative classification and GST Act objectives.
legal_provisions_cited: Eicher Motors Ltd. v. Union of India
final_judgment: Judgment details not provided; matters concerning constitutional validity of Section 17(5)(c) and (d) and read-down of provisions pending consideration.
